sections.heading: Pitch Overview
sections.text: Prepared on 20 May 2026, pitch SYN-SYNCP000026-P1 was put before Northstar Urgent Care 026 on behalf of SANOFI.

sections.heading: Put Forward in Exchange
sections.text: In exchange the Supplier put forward a group service charge of 2 per cent.

sections.heading: Sought in Return
sections.text: The Supplier sought a yearly Influenza minimum take of 1,600 doses in return.

sections.heading: Recorded Result
sections.text: Recorded result: the Customer signed off on the terms.
